sloka: तत्रोपविष्टं राजानमुपासन्ते विचक्षणाः ।कथानां बहुरूपाणां हास्यकाराः समन्ततः ।। ७.४३.१ ॥
transliteration: tatropaviṣṭaṁ rājānamupāsante vicakṣaṇāḥ ।kathānāṁ bahurūpāṇāṁ hāsyakārāḥ samantataḥ ।। 7.43.1 ॥

translations.english: There, wise men, jesters, and storytellers of various kinds surrounded and attended upon the seated king.
